description: Opens one record's event stream (ADR 0036 S12). Without a cursor the stream starts with what the event log and the log still hold, the record's oldest retained event and log byte, and is never refused for what retention removed; with one it starts after the item that carried it. Every refusal is answered before the WebSocket upgrade.

cursor.description: A cursor an item of this record's stream carried. A malformed one, or one another record's stream carried, is event.cursor-invalid, as on the event stream.
